description: The agent must: (1) Read the input JSON from company/travel/vendors/caocao_analysis_request.json to understand the four scenarios. (2) Apply Caocao-specific service taxonomy: recommend 惠选 for S001 (budget commute), 专车 for S002 (business reception, citing 着装规范/备水/开门 features), 专车 or 惠选 for S003 with mandatory night surcharge note (23:00-06:00 window) and safety feature callout (行程分享/SOS/录音) plus enterprise reimbursement discussion, and 顺风车 for S004 (long-distance, not in a rush, waiting acceptable). (3) Calculate cost estimates using the proprietary Caocao formula: 起步价12-15元 for 3km, then 2.5-3.0元/km, 0.5-0.8元/min — NOT the decoy taxi pricing in old_taxi_pricing_reference.json. (4) Include the exact customer service hotline 400-608-1111 (a trap for agents that hallucinate). (5) Describe enterprise account features (统一管理/月度账单/发票/用车规则). (6) Output all findings as caocao_travel_report.json.
